claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda not in {0,-1,...}, 1<=k<=M-1, top rows M-k..M-1 and any columns D_1<...<D_k (D>=M) of the neck block matrix Gamma: det Gamma[R,S] = (-1)^(k(k-1)/2)(prod beta_D/prod beta_m)(lambda-1)^k (M-k-1)!/M! det[sum_r b_r^s f_j(b_r)], f_(-1)=1, f_D=quo(int_0 quo(x^D,P)P,P); by Cauchy-Binet this is sum_T H_T det C[T], with H_T = sum over (k+1)-sets of Vandermonde^2 times a Schur polynomial, positive at positive roots.
claims.assessment: Working proof extending the discriminant-form proof (Steps 2-3 unchanged, bialternant formula); exact check at 300 random cases, M<=6, lambda=3/2,1/3.
claims.rationale: Gives a positive Hankel factor for all top-row neck block minors; reduces their signs and valuations to the quotient coefficient minors.

claims.summary: At each of six random positive points (M=3,4), the remainder-integral matrix [x^m]rem(int_0 x^t P,P) and the quotient-integral matrix [x^u]quo(int_0 x^t P,P) are not sign-regular, raw or after a checkerboard sign change: at every single point both signs occur among nonzero minors of every order below the top.
claims.assessment: Refutation by exact per-point evaluation; refutes only this factorization route, not sign regularity of Gamma.
claims.rationale: Rules out proving fixed signs of neck block minors by a sign-regular factorization through these matrices.

relationships: Refutes one route to its proof.
